provenance: Original synthetic LiquidBench Milestone 6 development fixture; not training or held-out data.
runtime_subset: Core Ruby Liquid with supplied hashes only; or static schema/reference contracts. No Shopify service emulation.
prompt: Repair snippets/option-list.liquid. options is an ordered array: value string, label null/string, disabled/selected booleans. Output ul class=options containing one li per non-disabled option in order, duplicates retained. li has only data-value equal to value and class selected if selected else option. Text is label, default Unnamed for null or empty string (do not trim). Emit an empty ul when no options qualify. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/option-list.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
